name: Conzent CMP
description: GDPR/CCPA/ePrivacy cookie-consent banner (IAB TCF v2.2) with optional GTM integration.
project_description:
GDPR, CCPA & ePrivacy compliant cookie consent banner for Drupal. IAB TCF v2.2 and Google CMP Certified (CMP #446).

 Features:

- Google Consent Mode v2

- Google Tag Manager integration

- Automatic cookie blocking

- 30+ language auto-translation

- Preference center with revisit consent

- Supports both Conzent Cloud and self-hosted (OCI) deployments

 Configure at Administration > Configuration > System > Conzent CMP.

 Requires Drupal 10 or 11, PHP 8.1+.
